# Bulk PDF Generator - React Project

This is a React + TypeScript project built with Vite.

## Available Scripts

- `npm run dev` - Start the development server
- `npm run build` - Build the project for production
- `npm run lint` - Run ESLint to check code quality
- `npm run preview` - Preview the production build

## Project Structure

- `src/` - Source files containing React components
- `public/` - Static assets
- `index.html` - Entry HTML file
- `vite.config.ts` - Vite configuration
- `tsconfig.json` - TypeScript configuration

## Getting Started

1. Install dependencies (already installed): `npm install`
2. Start the development server: `npm run dev`
3. Open the browser to the URL displayed in the terminal (typically http://localhost:5173)
